scoring_justification: DFT adsorption energies cannot be recomputed in the checker environment; scoring relies on comparison of agent-reported values against paper-reported gold with a tolerance of ±0.3 eV and verification of relative trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference adsorption energies from the paper (Fig.5 and text) for each surface-adsorbate combination.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DOI 10.1016/j.jhazmat.2021.126117, Section 3.5, Fig.5, and associated text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported DFT-calculated adsorption energies for the specific surfaces and adsorbates.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the original paper's results, which the reproduction aims to match.

outputs.description: Scored artifact: the checker compares each adsorption energy to the paper's reported values with absolute tolerance and verifies relative trends (e.g., SO₂ binds more strongly on TiO₂ than on MnO₂, K doping reduces NH₃ adsorption energy on MnO₂ by >0.5 eV).

output_contract.notes: Only the DFT-computed adsorption energies are scored; experimental characterisation and catalytic testing are not included. The agent must produce the values from first-principles calculations using the specified public resources.
